P01.title: Registry fallback loses nested argument payload
P01.fix: Scoped argument unwrapping strictly to W20 compat tools in comsol_mcp/_mcp_gateway.py and comsol_mcp/_managed_backend.py; preserved dict arguments for operation_call and registry calls.

P02.title: Task argument Map flattened for code.execute_java
P02.fix: Preserved arguments dict/Map structure without flattening when invoking code.execute_java in gateway and backend.

P03.title: setdefault does not replace an already-bound None default
P03.fix: Explicitly updated arguments when an outer default is None and inner wrapped dictionary supplies a non-None value; rejects conflicting arguments with INVALID_REQUEST.

P04.title: C10 positive validator test falsely passed when validate.solution returned isError=True / FAIL
P04.fix: Registered both 'transient_diffusion' and 'transient_sine_diffusion' in validator oracles; asserted assess_validator_response(call_result, 'PASS') in runner.

P05.title: Name-based exceptions suppress configured isolation proof
P05.fix: Deleted name-based exemptions (validate.*, plot.*) in _invoke_g3_model; strictly enforced isolation via REQUIRES_ISOLATION.

F01.title: C10 oracle mismatch and validator failure ignored
F01.fix: Registered transient_sine_diffusion; added explicit validator status assertion.

F02.title: Ambiguous model selection and expired revision auto-rewrite
F02.fix: Deleted ledger[0] fallback in _invoke_g2_model; raises AMBIGUOUS_TARGET on multiple models without explicit model_ref; raises REVISION_CONFLICT on expired revision instead of rewriting.

F03.title: Global argument flattening across non-W20 endpoints
F03.fix: Restricted argument extraction to declared W20 tools; rejects conflicting nested and top-level arguments.

F04.title: ObservationRef provenance and data integrity missing
F04.fix: Implemented ObservationRef dataclass with model_ref, dataset, solution_ref, timestamp, and SHA256 data digest; validated against bound model.

F05.title: Caller-supplied numbers masquerade as model-validated
F05.fix: Set scope='EXTERNAL_DATA_ONLY' and model_validated=False when ObservationRef is absent; requires valid ObservationRef for scope='MODEL_VALIDATED'.

F06.title: Convergence study accepts flat error trends
F06.fix: Rejected static/flat error sequences in ConvergenceStudy.analyze_trend.

F07.title: validate.report non-atomic writes and loose boolean parsing
F07.fix: Implemented safe path resolution via ArtifactStore; atomic staging via temporary files; strict boolean parsing for overwrite; prevents STATUS_UNKNOWN from falling through to STATUS_PASS.

F08.title: Energy conservation term verification lacks finite and tolerance validation
F08.fix: Added finite check (math.isfinite) on all conservation terms and requires tolerance > 0.
